Package index

Reading data

read_hdx()
Read HDX-MS data from HDXExaminer or DynamX
read_hdxexaminer()
Read an HDXExaminer "All results" table
read_dynamx()
Read a DynamX cluster or state data export
as_hdx_long()
Build HDXBoxeR input from a long table
nm_states()
Lists names of states in data sets
All_results_table
Example input: All_results_table.csv from HDXExaminer
three_states
Example input: three protein states with point mutations

Organizing data

Wide tables of replicate values used by every analysis.

output_tp()
Prepares output for HDX-MS for the deuteration uptake or percent deuteration for the time points.
output_tc()
Prepares output for HDX-MS for the deuteration uptake or percent deuteration for the time courses.
select_indices()
Allows for selecting some peptide from input data
boxer_input_to_long()
Prepares the long input of the input data
all_data_long_input()
Raw all_data input
output_FD()
Prepares output for HDX-MS Full deuteration data
output_FD_proc()
Prepares output for HDX-MS Full deuteration data for procent deuteration.
output_UD()
Prepares output for HDX-MS Undeuterated sample data.
output_UD_proc()
Prepares output for HDX-MS Undeuterated data for procent deuteration.

Data quality and summaries

peptide_qc()
Per-peptide quality checks of the input data
general_info()
Provides summary table for all data.sets.
backHX_calculations()
Summary of backexchange summary
summary_sd_CI()
Provides summary table with Critical interval and standard deviation within the set.
all_summary()
Returns full summary table.
nb_exch_deut()
Number of exchangeable protons
plot_peptide_coverage_map()
Plot peptide coverage map with per-residue redundancy

Statistics

Averages, SDs, Welch p-values and the Hageman & Weis critical interval.

ave_timepoint()
Returns average value for either uptake of procent data.
sd_timepoint()
Returns standard deviation for dataframe.
pv_timepoint()
Calculation of pvalue between first protein state and any other state from all_states file
dif_ave()
Returns data frame with difference of averages between State1 and other states provided.
sd_ci_timepoint()
Calculate what would be the standard deviation based on the CI
CI_2pts()
Global confidence interval treshold from experimental standard deviation for 2 samples.
CI_tp()
Global confidence interval treshold from experimental standard deviation
CI_single()
Global confidence interval treshold from experimental standard deviation for 1 sample
diff_peptides_prep()
Peptides significantly different between states

Comparing states

plot_fissure_vent()
Fissure_vent plot
compare_states_tp()
Compare peptide-level HDX uptake across three or more protein states
plot_compare_states_tp()
Plot per-peptide deltas from compare_states_tp(), by state pair and region
compare_regions()
Region-level ANOVA: compare protein states within residue regions
compare_timecourse()
Compare two states over a whole time course
compare_states_unmatched()
Compare pooled peptide-level HDX uptake across states without matching peptides
plot_compare_states_unmatched()
Plot the pooled distributions behind compare_states_unmatched()
plot_coverage_diagnostics()
Plot the peptide-map coverage diagnostics from compare_states_unmatched()
residue_regions()
Cluster significant peptides into contiguous destabilized/protected regions
residue_regions_subset_summary()
Roll up derived regions against named residue subsets

Per-residue values

residue_deconvolution()
Per-residue deconvolution of HDX-MS uptake from overlapping peptides
residue_level_average()
Per-residue uptake as a length-weighted mean across covering peptides

Plots - time points

Uptake (*_tp) and percent-deuteration (*_proc) versions; the _proc functions show differences in percent deuteration and test significance on the uptake table.

plots_av_tp()
Returns average deuteration plot for timepoints in the data frame
plots_av_tp_proc()
Returns average procent deuteration plot for time points
plots_diff_tp()
Returns difference in average plot for timepoints in the data frame
plots_diff_tp_proc()
Returns difference in average procent deuteration plot for timepoints in the data frame
plots_vol_tp()
Returns volcano plots for timepoints in the data frame
plot_heat_map_tp()
Plots heat maps for significant peptides.
plot_heat_map_tp_proc()
Plots heat maps for significant peptides.
plot_heat_map_max_uptake_tp()
Plots heat maps for maximum uptake per residue.
plot_heat_map_max_uptake_tp_proc()
Plots heat maps for maximum procent deuteration per residue.
plot_peptide_sig_tp()
Significant peptide plots.
plot_peptide_sig_tp_proc()
Draws peptides with significant difefrences between sets.
boxplot_tp()
Plots boxplots for all the averages in the set
deuteration_woods_timepoints()
Return woods plots for the timepoints
deuteration_woods_timepoints_frac()
Return woods plots for the timepoints
deuteration_woods_timepoints_frac_list()
Return woods plots for the timepoints
plot_cor_pts_elps()
Correlation functions plots and prep data
plot_correlation_functions()
Plot correlated states

plot_heat_map_tc()
Plots heat maps for time courses.
uptake_plots()
Uptake plots
robot_plot_All()

robot_indexes()

robot_indexes_df()
Returns dataframe with peptides which exhibit significant difference between two sets
woods_CI_plot()
Returns a woods plot for comparisons of the timepoints samples
woods_CI_plot_frac()
Returns a woods plot for comparisons of the timepoints samples
deuteration_woods_timecourse()
Return woods plots for the timecourse
deuteration_woods_timecourse_frac()
Return woods plots for the timecourse
average_timecourse()
Calculates average for time course data.
sd_timecourse()

sd_timecourse_proc()
